Name: Heart-Breaking Smite
Description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon’s figure distorts to seem cracked and its material slowly melting. The attack deals an additional 2d6 cold damage to the target and inflicts half the damage dealt (rounded down.) as counts of Sinking.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
